claims.statement: Management believes that the liquidity position, anticipated future internally generated funds from operations, and fully available revolving undrawn credit facility will enable the company to meet its future known obligations.
claims.quote: The Company believes that its liquidity position (₹ 9,014.60 crores as at 31st March 2026 (Previous Year-  ₹ 4,533.55 crores)), anticipated future internally generated funds from operations, and its fully available revolving undrawn credit facility will enable it to meet its future known obligations in the ordinary course of business.

facts.statement: The Group is engaged in the manufacturing, selling and distribution of paints, coatings, home decor products, bath fittings, modular kitchens, decorative lighting, uPVC doors and windows, and related services.
facts.quote: The Group is engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling and distribution of paints, coatings, products related to home décor, bath fittings, modular kitchen & accessories, decorative lighting, uPVC doors & windows and providing related services.
